observations: The poem is the first numbered lesson. It calls listeners together to recall Odisha's past.
Names include BuxiJagabandhu,ChandanHajuri,Gopabandhu andBajiRout; Dharma/Dharmapada andPaika/Tosali episodes are poetic remembrance, not independently verified history.
The poet note identifies BiraGitika as source collection. Current textbook reuse does not establish when he wrote it, its first publication or universal current school adoption.
The accompanying questions ask students to interpret the poem's references and themes.
